integrity: The all-size proof is analytic; two independent finite verification scripts are included and are not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact basin of a specified orbit, not a complete wheel attractor census. Historical equivalence remains possible; one older source was available only as an abstract. General one-step periodicity and Lucas counting ingredients are not asserted novel.
title: A dominant NOR oscillator on every wheel: an exact parity-sensitive Lucas basin
